reason: Holds a write until the address is announced, which the release's hook does not, at 0.16.3 as at 0.15.0. 0.16.3's hook still reads the address through Next's useSearchParams and shows a press through useOptimistic only until its transition settles; this one reads the address through src/lib/address.ts and owes its readers two things for that: they are told once the navigation has committed, and a write stays shown until they are told. The transition settles one render before that, and a search box kept with the release's useSearchDraft took the address as it was before the write for a change from elsewhere: on /teams a key typed up to 40 ms after the box's own write was lost in 15 of 24 trials, and in 0 of 24 with the write held (2026-10-14). tests/query-state-search.test.tsx holds it: with 0.16.3's file in its place, all 4 of its cases fail (Harbormaster job 2837, 2026-10-17), because its router answers useSearchParams with an error, as it did against 0.15.0's. The prerender cost that was this entry's first reason is gone now that every page is gated on the request (measured 2026-10-14: /teams, /people and /activity painted alike with this file and the release's). Reported upstream as zz-meridian#22, closed; this entry comes out when the release holds a write until its readers are told.

The product's own period vocabulary: the agents' view tools offer the gateway's 24-hour period ('1d', which the gateway's PERIOD_DAYS reads) and all time as the default, as the gateway's own default is; a console that opens on 30 days shows a total that is not the total. This file is 0.24.0's with exactly those two changes, which its own comment says a product makes here and names in this register. Put back as the release has it, tests/period.test.ts fails on the missing period and the default. Reported upstream as zz-meridian#24.
